Problem Statement

Wallet-to-wallet transfers currently rely on synchronous calls between payment-platform and walletapi. We want to introduce an event-driven backbone for cross-system wallet state propagation.

Solution

Stand up a `WalletEventPublisher` in payment-platform and a corresponding consumer in walletapi. Persistence is via the existing Axon event store.

Out of Scope

Reconciliation tooling for divergence between publisher and consumer. (Deferred to a follow-up PRD.)
